notes:
1.3.6: DS3231 on the touch bus or on GPIO 44 / 43 (found at start-up)

The RTC is looked for on the touch I2C bus first (SDA 19 / SCL 45, as before),
then on its own I2C port with RTC_SDA_PIN / RTC_SCL_PIN from config.h (SDA 44 /
SCL 43, the UART0 pins: the serial log is off while the RTC uses them and comes
back if no DS3231 answers there). Debug console: baud command.
